title: Unscented KalmanNet: Structure-Preserving Deep Learning with Calibrated Posterior Uncertainty under Incomplete Physics and Unknown Noise
abstract: arXiv:2608.04201v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Nonlinear state estimation requires sequentially fusing model-based predictions with noisy measurements. Under imperfect dynamics and unknown, time-varying noise statistics, this fusion can degrade in both accuracy and statistical consistency. Existing learning-aided filters largely treat accuracy and uncertainty estimation separately, limiting their ability to correct model-mismatch-induced bias while retaining an explicit, calibrated posterior covariance. This paper introduces Unscented KalmanNet (UKN), a model-based deep learning architecture that extends the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) with learned mechanisms for these two sources of filtering error while preserving explicit posterior covariance propagation. translated_title: 无迹卡尔曼网络：在不完全物理模型和未知噪声下保持结构并校准后验不确定性的深度学习方法
translated_abstract: 非线性状态估计需要依次融合基于模型的预测与含噪声的测量。在动力学不完美且噪声统计未知且随时间变化的情况下，这种融合在准确性和统计一致性上都会退化。现有的学习辅助滤波器大多将准确性和不确定性估计分开处理，限制了其在保留显式、校准后验协方差的同时纠正模型失配引起的偏差的能力。本文介绍了无迹卡尔曼网络（UKN），一种基于模型的深度学习架构，它扩展了无迹卡尔曼滤波器（UKF），通过学习机制来处理这两类滤波误差，同时保留显式后验协方差的传播。噪声网络（NoiseNet）学习随时间变化的过程和测量协方差，作为基线协方差的有界乘性修正，确保正定性，而增益网络（GainNet）学习对先验修正的有界残差校正。
tldr: 本文提出无迹卡尔曼网络，通过噪声网络和增益网络分别学习协方差修正和增益残差校正，在不完全物理模型和未知噪声下实现准确且后验不确定性校准的状态估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Unscented KalmanNet, which learns covariance and gain corrections via NoiseNet and GainNet to achieve accurate state estimation with calibrated posterior uncertainty under incomplete physics and unknown noise.
